scope: Native Android x86_64 APK and emulator validation profile; physical devices and arm64 acceptance are separate

placeholders.<android-sdk>: Existing Android SDK with the exact selected platform/build-tools/NDK/CMake packages
placeholders.<android-deps>: Isolated dependency layout described by dependency-receipts.json
placeholders.<interop-assets>: Generated SDK/probe/model/entry asset directory bound by its own manifest

toolchain.kotlinPluginDeclared: 1.9.22 apply false; app sources are Java

java.source: Pre-existing local toolchain; not downloaded or installed by this task

javac.source: Pre-existing local toolchain; not downloaded or installed by this task

ndkSource.source: Pre-existing local toolchain; not downloaded or installed by this task

clang.source: Pre-existing local toolchain; not downloaded or installed by this task

cmake.source: Pre-existing local toolchain; not downloaded or installed by this task

ninja.source: Pre-existing local toolchain; not downloaded or installed by this task

v8.import: SHARED libv8android.so selected strictly by ANDROID_ABI
v8.platform: Original NewDefaultPlatform; no single-thread/tracing experiment in the APK
v8.snapshotInitialization: Extract to an absolute regular private file and set MYSTRAL_V8_SNAPSHOT before InitializeExternalStartupDataFromFile

dawn.backend: Vulkan; real AdapterInfo checked and Null rejected

skia.import: STATIC archives in a linker group, Android-only paths

nativeProfile.sdl3: 3.2.8 AAR Java classes and matching Prefab SHARED native library
nativeProfile.http: Android Java HttpURLConnection through JNI; real sync/async headers; no Android curl substitution
nativeProfile.async: std::thread and main-thread completion queue; genuine existing async-file/timer fallbacks preserved

packaging.snapshots: Selected ABI only; file and library SHA must match the dependency receipt
packaging.signing: Local debug APK signing; publication signing is outside this profile

acceptance.build: Actual assembleDebug success plus signed APK and exact ZIP payload/source/asset receipts
acceptance.runnable: Separate recorded installation and app/native startup on the selected emulator
acceptance.graphics: Separate true Vulkan, WASM, PixelCopy/fullscreen evidence
acceptance.shutdown: Separate original 10-second native-exit acknowledgement gate; do not move exit acknowledgement before teardown
acceptance.candidateIdentity: Selected only by the final delivery manifest, not this reusable profile
